spec.description: Observability for superset-reporting-mediator: HTTP traffic, latency, errors, S3 transfers, SQS API calls, message-processing attempts, Superset authentication, Superset service operations, end-to-end report outcomes, file validation, and local disk usage.

spec.title: Request Rate
spec.description: HTTP requests per second across all service instances.

spec.title: Error Rate (4xx + 5xx)
spec.description: Fraction of requests with 4xx or 5xx status. A missing error series is treated as zero only when a total-request series exists. No traffic leaves the ratio undefined.

spec.title: Median Latency (P50)
spec.description: Estimated 50th percentile HTTP request duration, not arithmetic average latency.

spec.title: P95 Latency
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile HTTP request duration.

spec.title: P99 Latency
spec.description: Estimated 99th percentile HTTP request duration.

spec.title: Total Requests (Selected Period)
spec.description: Estimated request count over the selected dashboard time range. Prometheus increase may produce fractional values because of extrapolation.

spec.title: Request Rate by Endpoint
spec.description: HTTP requests per second grouped by endpoint.

spec.title: Traffic Share by Endpoint
spec.description: Share of the current request rate, not total traffic over the selected period.

spec.title: Latency Percentiles (P50 / P95 / P99) — All Endpoints
spec.description: Estimated HTTP latency percentiles aggregated across all endpoints and service instances.

spec.title: P95 Latency by Endpoint
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile HTTP latency grouped by endpoint.

spec.title: Errors / sec by Status Code
spec.description: HTTP 4xx and 5xx errors per second, not a cumulative error count.

spec.title: Error Rate (%) by Endpoint
spec.description: 4xx and 5xx fraction per endpoint. Zero-error endpoints are included when total-request data exists; no-traffic ratios remain undefined.

spec.expr: (sum by (endpoint) (rate(http_requests_total{job="superset-reporting-mediator",status_code=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (endpoint) (rate(http_requests_total{job="superset-reporting-mediator"}[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (endpoint) (rate(http_requests_total{job="superset-reporting-mediator"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Endpoint Summary — Rate / P95 Latency / Error Rate
spec.description: Current endpoint metrics, sorted by request rate.

spec.expr: (sum by (endpoint) (rate(http_requests_total{job="superset-reporting-mediator",status_code=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (endpoint) (rate(http_requests_total{job="superset-reporting-mediator"}[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (endpoint) (rate(http_requests_total{job="superset-reporting-mediator"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Request Rate by HTTP Method
spec.description: HTTP requests per second grouped by method.

spec.title: 2xx vs 4xx vs 5xx Rate
spec.description: HTTP request rate by status class. A class may be absent until its first request is recorded.

spec.title: S3 Operations / sec
spec.description: Completed S3 service operations per second by operation and outcome, including cancellations.

spec.title: S3 Errors (Selected Period)
spec.description: Estimated failed S3 operation count over the selected period. No data is not automatically treated as zero; outcome series may not exist before their first observation.

spec.title: S3 P95 Duration
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile service-operation duration, including local file I/O and unsuccessful or cancelled attempts.

spec.title: S3 Successful Transfer Throughput
spec.description: Bytes per second credited to completed successful transfers. Excludes partial failures and SDK retry traffic; this is not instantaneous network bandwidth.

spec.title: Active S3 Operations
spec.description: Current S3 operations in progress across scraped service instances. Higher concurrency is not automatically an error.

spec.title: SQS API Calls / sec
spec.description: Completed receive, send, delete, and change-visibility calls by outcome. Excludes message-processing attempts.

spec.title: Messages Received / sec
spec.description: SQS deliveries per second, including redeliveries. This is not a unique-message or successful-report count.

spec.title: SQS Processing Decisions / sec
spec.description: ack_requested means processing returned True, including permanent business failures. retry_requested means the message was retained, not that a retry occurred. Neither proves deletion or DLQ delivery.

spec.title: SQS Processing P95
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile duration of a single process_message attempt, including error handling and notification. Excludes queue waiting time and final deletion.

spec.title: SQS API P95
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile API wrapper duration by operation. Receive includes long polling, so approximately 20 seconds can be normal.

spec.title: Messages Being Processed
spec.description: Current process_message attempts across scraped service instances. This is not the queue backlog or SQS approximate in-flight count.

spec.title: SQS Errors (Selected Period)
spec.description: Estimated operation-error count over the selected period. Handled processing failures may appear as retry_requested or ack_requested rather than error. Missing outcome series are not forced to zero.

spec.title: Superset Auth Operations / sec
spec.description: Completed Superset login/refresh/token-fetch operations per second by operation and outcome, including cancellations.

spec.title: Superset Auth Errors (Selected Period)
spec.description: Estimated failed Superset authentication operation count over the selected period. No data is not automatically treated as zero; outcome series may not exist before their first observation.

spec.title: Superset Auth P95 Duration
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile duration of Superset login, refresh, and token-fetch operations.

spec.title: Active Superset Auth Operations
spec.description: Current Superset authentication operations in progress across scraped service instances. Higher concurrency is not automatically an error.

spec.title: Superset Service Operations / sec
spec.description: Completed Superset service operations per second (roles, permissions, dashboards, charts, chart data) by operation and outcome, including cancellations.

spec.title: Superset Service Errors (Selected Period)
spec.description: Estimated failed Superset service operation count over the selected period. No data is not automatically treated as zero; outcome series may not exist before their first observation.

spec.title: Superset Service P95 Duration
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile duration of Superset service operations, including dependent API calls and downstream S3 downloads.

spec.title: Active Superset Service Operations
spec.description: Current Superset service operations in progress across scraped service instances. Higher concurrency is not automatically an error.

spec.title: Report Requests / sec
spec.description: Completed end-to-end report requests (SQS -> Superset -> S3) per second by visualization type and status.

spec.title: Report Failures (Selected Period)
spec.description: Estimated failed report requests by tenant over the selected period. No data is not automatically treated as zero.

spec.title: Report Size (Rows) Percentiles
spec.description: Estimated P50/P95 row counts for successfully generated reports.

spec.title: Report File Size P95
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile size of successfully generated report files.

spec.title: Validation Operations / sec
spec.description: Completed report file validation/cleaning operations per second by outcome.

spec.title: Validation P95 Duration
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile validation/cleaning duration.

spec.title: SQS Message Outcomes / sec
spec.description: Terminal outcomes reached while processing SQS messages (success, notified failures, retry-scheduled, DLQ-released), per second.

spec.title: SQS Queue Depth
spec.description: Approximate number of visible messages in the queue, sampled once per poll cycle. This is an AWS estimate, not an exact count.

spec.title: SQS Listener Consecutive Errors
spec.description: Current consecutive receive-error streak in the SQS polling loop. Resets to zero after a successful receive.

spec.title: Local Disk Free
spec.description: Free bytes on local disk, sampled before each chart data download. Low values can cause downloads to fail.

spec.title: Local Disk Used
spec.description: Used bytes on local disk, sampled before each chart data download.

spec.title: Chart Data P95 Duration by Backend
spec.description: Estimated 95th percentile chart-data retrieval duration split by dataset backend (awsathena S3 export vs streamed postgresql).

spec.title: Superset Reporting Mediator
